identificationModule.briefTitle: Radiation Therapy in Treating Patients With Stage II Prostate Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase III Randomized Study Of High Dose 3D-CRT/IMRT Versus Standard Dose 3D-CRT/IMRT In Patients Treated For Localized Prostate Cancer

interventions.name: 70.2 Gy 3D-CRT/IMRT
interventions.description: Radiation will be delivered via 3D conformal radiation therapy (3D-CRT) or intensity modulated radiation therapy (IMRT) in 1.8 Gy minimum dose fractions to a total of 70.2 Gy in 39 Fractions. All fields treated once daily, five fractions per week. No more than 2% of the planning target volume and none of the clinical target volume may receive less than 70.2 Gy.

interventions.name: 79.2 Gy 3D-CRT/IMRT
interventions.description: Radiation will be delivered via 3D conformal radiation therapy (3D-CRT) or intensity modulated radiation therapy (IMRT) in 1.8 Gy minimum dose fractions to a total of 79.2 Gy in 44 fractions. All fields treated once daily, five fractions per week. No more than 2% of the planning target volume and none of the clinical target volume may receive less than 79.2 Gy.
